preamble.purpose: To ensure all development activities are undertaken under the aegis of the Bangalore Master Plan-2031 and to guide the same in accordance with planning norms and standards.
objectives: Promoting in achieving the optimum built form with minimal building parameters
Factoring in the costs required to be recouped in part for the implementation of the Revised Master Plan
Taking into consideration the metropolitan dimension of Bengaluru and helping in sustaining it

regulation_title: Zoning Regulations - 2031 for Local Planning Area of Bangalore Development Authority of the Revised Master Plan for Bengaluru - 2031
enabling_legislation: Section 12 of the Karnataka Town & Country Planning Act, 1961
jurisdiction: Areas under the jurisdiction of the Bangalore Development Authority (Bengaluru Metropolitan Area)

zoning_objectives_and_provisions.detail: Categorization allows compatible uses and activities requiring higher planning inputs, site/locational scrutiny, with many activities categorized as permissible by the Authority.
source_clauses: The land use categorization is therefore not a rigid one but one that allows compatible uses and those activities that require higher level of planning input s, site and locational requirements and scrutiny, and many of the activities are grouped under permissible by the Authority.

zoning_objectives_and_provisions.detail: Promotes land aggregation for planned development, improved infrastructure execution, and integration of sub-divisions, layouts, and development plans.
source_clauses: The Zoning Regulations specially focus on promoting land aggregation in order to ensure the planned development and better planning and execution of i nfrastructure facilities.
The necessary provisions have also been made to ensure integration of various sub-divisions/ layouts and development plans.

zoning_objectives_and_provisions.detail: Applies to all building activity and/or development work in areas under BDA jurisdiction.
source_clauses: These Regulations shall apply to all building activity and/or developme nt work in the areas under the jurisdiction of the Bangalore Development Authority (BDA)

source_clauses.regulation_title: These Regulations may be called the Zoning Regulations - 2031 for Local Plan ning Area of Bangalore Development Authority of the Revised Master Plan for Bengaluru - 2031.
source_clauses.enabling_legislation: In pursuance of the provisions contained in Section 12 of the Karnat aka Town & Country Planning Act, 1961
source_clauses.competent_authority: Bangalore Development Authority (BDA) (hereinafter called "the Competent Authority")
source_clauses.jurisdiction: The areas under the jurisdiction of the Bangalore Development Authority.

jurisdiction: Bangalore Development Authority / Local Planning Area
effective_date_condition: Date of approval of the Revised Master Plan-2031 for Bengaluru by the Government through notification

covered_developments: mining, quarrying and brick kiln operations
additions and alterations to existing use or occupancies
source_clauses: These Regulations shall be applicable to all types and categories of develop ment, viz., development/sub- division of land, area development schemes, land assemblage /land pooling schemes, mining, quarrying and brick kiln operations, building construction, change of use/activity, additions and alterati ons to existing use or occupancies, etc.

Prior clearance from the Deputy Commissioner (Revenue) for certain activities like petroleum storage/ products, cinema theatre/ multiplex cinema cases, before applying for building/development permissions in such cases etc. shall be obtained as required under these regulations.

legal_status.superseded_scope: all existing Rules, Regulations and orders dealing wi th layout and building construction activity
legal_status.duration: till such time these are revised, approved and superseded by the next Revised Master Plan and/ or amendment by Government through notification
legal_status.savings_clause: Any action taken or developments permitted/ approved by the Authority under the Regulations/ Building bylaws existing prior to these Regulations coming in to force, shall deemed to be valid and continue to be so valid
source_clauses: These regulations supersede all existing Rules, Regulations and orders dealing wi th layout and building construction activity.

These regulations together w ith the land uses shall continue to be in force till such time these are revised, a pproved and superseded by the next Revised Master Plan and/ or amendment by Government through notification for the areas under jurisdiction of Bangalore D evelopment Authority.

Any action taken or developments permitted/ approved by the Authority u nder the Regulations/ Building bylaws existing prior to these Regulations coming in to force, shall deemed to be valid and continue to be so valid

definitions.definition: means a clear approach to a plot or a building.
source_clauses: 2.1 Access: means a clear approach to a plot or a building.

definitions.definition: Means the Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act (KTCP, Act), 1961.
source_clauses: 2.2 Act: Means the Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act (KTCP, Act), 1961.

definitions.definition: Means a structural change including an addition to the area or change in height or the removal of part of building, or any change to the structure, such as the construction or removal or cutting of any wall or part of a wall, partition, column, beam, joist, floor including a mezzanine floor or other support, or a change to or closing of any required means of access ingress or egress or a change to fixtures or equipment as provided in these Zonal Regulations.
source_clauses: 2.3 Addition and/ or Alteration: Means a structural change including an addition to the area or change in height or the removal of part of building, or any c hange to the structure...

definitions.definition: includes horticulture, farming, growing of crops, fruits, vegetables, flowers, grass, fodder, trees or any kind of cultivation of soil, breeding and keeping of livestock including cattle, horses, donkeys, mules, pigs, fish, poultry and bees, the use of land which is ancillary to the farming of land or any purpose aforesaid, but shall not include the use of any land attached to a building for the purposes of garden to be used along with such building; and 'agricultural' shall be construed accordingly.
source_clauses: 2.4 Agriculture: includes horticulture, farming, growing of crops, fruits, vegetables, flowers, grass, fodder, trees or any kind of cultivation of soil...

definitions.definition: Means an industry concerned with the production and processing of agricultural products. It may include oil mills, roller flour mills, seeds processing units, etc., but excludes all agro – chemical units like fertilizer plants, pesticides / insecticides, etc.
source_clauses: 2.5 Agro- based industry: Means an industry concerned with the production and processing of agricultural products.

definitions.definition: means clubbing of two or more authorised properties as a single property.
source_clauses: 2.6 Amalgamation: means clubbing of two or more authorised properties as a single property.

definitions.definition: Means a premises having park and ground for public amusement containing entertainment and fun / rides equipment like swings, joy rides, roller coaster, Ferris wheel, Water Park, etc. It includes related facilities like cafeteria, children play area, swimming pool, picnic huts, mini zoo, aqua
source_clauses: 2.7 Amusement Park: Means a premises having park and ground for public amusement containing entertainment and fun / rides equipment like swings, joy rides, roller coaster, Ferris wheel, Water Park, etc.

governing_law: Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act, 1961

definitions.definition: Means any use of the premises subordinate to the principal use and customarily incidental to the principal use.
source_clauses: 2.8 Ancillary Use: Means any use of the premises subordinate to the principal use and customarily incidental to the principal use.

definitions.definition: means suits of rooms, which are occupied or which is intended or designed to be occupied by one family for living purpose in an Apart ment building. This word is synonymous with residential flat.
source_clauses: 2.9 Apartment: means suits of rooms, which are occupied or which is intended or designed to be occupied by one family for living purpose in an Apart ment building. This word is synonymous with residential flat.

definitions.definition: means one or more buildings, containing or meant for multi-family dwellings and contains more than four dwelling units.
source_clauses: 2.10 Apartment Building/ Multi-Dwelling Unit Building: means one or more buildings, containing or meant for multi-family dwellings and contains more tha n four dwelling units.

definitions.definition: means any person who applies to the Authority with an intention to develop land or building as per these regulations. The applicant shall be the owner of the property or his authorised representative or the promoter authorised by the land owner.
source_clauses: 2.11 Applicant: means any person who applies to the Authority with an intention to develop land or building as per these regulations. The applicant shall be the owner of the property or his authorised representative or the promoter autho rised by the land owner.

definitions.definition: means any building or part of a building, where 50 persons or more congregate or gather for amusement, recreation, social, religious, patriotic, civil, travel and similar purposes.
source_clauses: 2.12 Assembly Building: means any building or part of a building, where 50 persons or more congregate or gather for amusement, recreation, social, religious, patriotic, civil, travel and similar purposes.

definitions.definition: means Premises having an enclosed space to seat audience and stage for various performances such as concerts, plays, music etc.
source_clauses: 2.13 Auditorium: means Premises having an enclosed space to seat audience and stage for various performances such as concerts, plays, music etc.

definitions.definition: means Planning Authority constituted for Bengaluru Local Planning Area under the provisions of Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act, 1961
source_clauses: 2.14 Authority: means Planning Authority constituted for Bengaluru Local Planning Area under the provisions of Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act, 1961

definitions.definition: means a horizontal cantilever projection including a handrail or balustrade, to serve as passage or sit out place.
source_clauses: 2.15 Balcony: means a horizontal cantilever projection including a handrail or b alustrade, to serve as passage or sit out place.

definitions.definition: means any storey, which is partly / wholly below the average ground level contiguous to the building, with one or more than one level.
source_clauses: 2.16 Basement or cellar: means any storey, which is partly / wholly below the average ground level contiguous to the building, with one or more than o ne level.
